float32.note: required precision for hub_cost accumulation and routing_weight derivation

float16.note: reduced dynamic range; not suitable for hub_cost accumulation

bfloat16.note: same exponent range as float32; preferred for checkpoint storage. gradient accumulation requires float32 for numerical stability

entropy_norm.guard: must satisfy ENTROPY_BOUNDS before Xul admission

float:authority-boundary: float data is raw material — confers no semantic authority
routing_weights and hub_costs are projection signals only
pi_routing_weight = 1.0 - hub_cost is a derived candidate, not a verified claim
entropy_out (levity signal) is a distributional measure, not a truth value
Ch'en VERIFY ENTROPY_BOUNDS required before float signals advance to Xul
NaN and Inf must produce status=1 in pi_triangle_hub_costs and pi_triangle_softmax
float values in srai_xcfe_propose envelope are DATA_ONLY fields
float:precision-contract: float32 required for hub_costs and routing_weights (accumulation precision)
float16 acceptable for embedding storage after normalization
bfloat16 acceptable for checkpoint storage; gradient accumulation requires float32
mixed precision requires explicit cast annotation at lane boundary
NaN and Inf must produce status=1 in pi_triangle_hub_costs and pi_triangle_softmax
JSON numeric values do not preserve float16/bfloat16 representation; loader must convert and validate
range [0.0, 1.0] enforced at Ch'en for hub_cost, pi_routing_weight, entropy_norm

float:phase-affinity.Pop: embedgemma_prompt_vectorize emits float32 vectors; srai_intent_detect carries float metadata
float:phase-affinity.Wo: srai_recursion_guard_init binds evidence_budget (integer) and depth (integer); no float accumulation
float:phase-affinity.Yax: pi_triangle_route computes hub_costs[t*3+i] = 0.5*(r_ij+r_ik) in float32 via pi-routing-weight.cl
float:phase-affinity.Sek: routing_weights[k] = 1.0 - hub_costs[k]; srai_xcfe_propose packages float fields as DATA_ONLY
float:phase-affinity.Ch'en: verify_srai_recursion_limits checks entropy_norm in [0,1]; VERIFY ENTROPY_BOUNDS + PROXIMITY_CONTRACT
float:phase-affinity.Xul: fold_reasoning_result emits float32 routing signals as data_only fields; FEL replay records values

float:kernel-ref: float32 throughout; no mixed-precision in kernel layer
float:type-hierarchy: float → tensor (tensors are built on float data)
float → vector (vectors are float32 coordinate tuples)
float → metric (metric edge costs are float32)
